title: 润泽说 道可道：一套用同一把标尺重读九部经典的读本
desc: 作者润泽以同一把标尺「佛说A—即非A—是名A」重解道德经、易传、心经、庄子、金刚经、坛经六部，另列甲骨文、千字文、三字经；约188万字，均有DOI存档、网页版与安卓离线包。

title: Runze Says: Dao Ke Dao — One Measuring Stick, Nine Re-read Classics
desc: Six classics (Daodejing, Yizhuan, Heart Sutra, Zhuangzi, Diamond Sutra, Platform Sutra) re-read with one stick: A spoken, yet not A, named A. Plus oracle-bone character study and two primers; ~1.88M chars, DOI archive, web and offline Android editions.
